details: 288 mux file byte comparisons vs native writing a seekable file: {pcm_s32le,pcm_s32be} x channels {1,2,3,6} x rates {8000,44100,96000} x lengths {0,1,67,4097} x sources {s16le,s32le,f32le} (-cpuflags 0 for f32le)

190 demux byte comparisons: native-written files (2 codecs x 1/2/3/6 channels, auto-detected and -f sox) through copy framecrc, decoded framecrc, -ss/-t (input/output), -frames:a 2, -af volume=0.5, -guess_layout_max 0 and 2, WAV, AIFF (<=2 channels), s16le decode, -ss with volume; plus 6 hand-built header-padding/fractional-rate files through framecrc and s16le

31 exit-status comparisons: 13 malformed headers x {detected,-f sox} = 26 matched 183 (zero-channel detected case: native 183 undetected, Edge exit 1 'Unsupported audio container signature'); 5 native-accepted unmirrored inputs checked against native status (0 or 234) with Edge explicit refusal
4 muxer codec refusals (pcm_s16le, pcm_f32le, pcm_s24le, pcm_u8) match native exit 234, no Edge output created
FATE lavf-sox: md5 683635d5cb1344e44fa96df90c3a993c and size 176432 exact; identical to native running the FATE command; native crc 0x3a1da17e; copy framecrc decode identical

unsupported: SoX comments on input (refused, exit 1) and output (no metadata reaches muxers)

Rates truncating to 0 Hz: refused with exit 234 (native's decoder also fails with 234)
Undetected (sox_probe-failing) input: Edge exit 1 vs native 183
Channel conversion other than mono/stereo (backend refusal)
Non-seekable/pipe and unknown-length output, FLAC input to the SoX muxer, Workers/R2 runs and macOS reproducibility were not run

notes: Setup durations: submodule init 43s (946fcce0 matches compat/upstream.lock.json), npm ci 8s, reference:build 200s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 59s, baseline unit 81s.
Native-INVALIDDATA header refusals use containerRefusal(message,183) so exit codes match native; unmirrored inputs use SoxError (exit 1) or 234 where native fails with EINVAL.

The demuxer passes a null channel mask so the backend's -guess_layout_max rules match native for the unspecified SoX layout (verified for -guess_layout_max 0 and 2). A default mask would misreport -guess_layout_max below the channel count, because declared.guessLayout is computed from one channel for non-headerless inputs.
Needed shared edit, not made: the AIFF muxer would need native CHAN layout tags for guessed >=2.1 layouts to match native for >=3-channel SoX (and raw) inputs.
Native to stdout leaves WAV sizes unset (non-seekable), so WAV/AIFF demux comparisons write native output to a file.
The FATE test compiles upstream tests/audiogen.c with cc at test time; -metadata title does not reach the SoX header, so Edge runs the command without it.
